answer: For each epoch—mesa, dune, or nadir—an agent deposits bonded stake, joins the Semaphore zero-knowledge tree, and commits to an identity polynomial. Each rate-limited message carries a proof tied to its epoch and polynomial evaluation. Reusing the same quota exposes two distinct Shamir shares; interpolation reconstructs the registered private key, enabling deterministic RLN attribution and immediate slashing of the bonded collateral.
